messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: spike of 5xx + streaming disconnects reported for streaming-gateway in us-east-1. Error rate ~12% over last 5m, SLO impact on low-latency streaming paths. Paging on-call.
Anna: I'm on it, grabbing graphs now. Links: https://grafana.internal/streams?range=5m (high error rates on /v1/stream and increased 5025/timeout counts)
Raj: seeing a big bump in upstream TLS resets and chunked-encoding errors in the gateway logs. Sample from 3 nodes:
```
2026-03-15T10:05:22Z ERROR stream-handler: upstream reset: ECONNRESET (client cancel?) id=0x9f4
2026-03-15T10:05:23Z WARN  chunk-assembler: unexpected EOF while parsing chunked body
2026-03-15T10:05:24Z ERROR http-proxy: 502 downstream closed connection while streaming
```
Mia: any change rollouts in the last hour? kube events show a configmap update 45m ago for streaming-buffer-size but no deploys.
Anna: nope no deploys. Could be a config regressing for large chunked responses. Increasing backlog leads to partial frames.
Sasha: quick mitigation idea: switch heavy traffic route to paged fallback (non-streaming) for affected customers/paths until we stabilize. We can flip routing rule in the gateway feature flags.
Raj: agree. Also propose to temporarily increase upstream keepalive/timeout to reduce premature resets. Sending command to patch nginx: 
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it gateway-config -- sed -i 's/keepalive_timeout  20;/keepalive_timeout  60;/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/gateway
```
Anna: on it. I'm toggling the feature-flag to route /v1/stream -> /v1/paged for customers with heavy concurrent streams.
Anna: FLAG:streaming_fallback: us-east-1=true (applied)
oncall-bot: handoff: @raj is now primary oncall for incidents, previous oncall acknowledged.
Raj: taking lead. Rapid checklist:
- Confirm customer impact (who is seeing failures / percent)
- Apply routing fallback for heavy clients
- Adjust keepalive/timeout
- Restart a subset of affected gateway pods for state purge
- Collect heap/conn stats from restarted pods
Mia: I patched keepalive and restarted one node (gw-5). Observed immediate drop in resets on that node in logs. Others still noisy.
Sasha: rolling restart small batch (2 pods) to avoid mass disruption. Command:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/streaming-gateway --selector=zone=use1a --timeout=5m
```
Anna: rolling restart started. Also enabling extra logging (chunk-id) for postmortem.
Raj: monitors: error rate dipped from 12% to ~4% after the patch + fallback flip. But some clients still see disconnects — likely client cancels + partial chunk corruption.
Mia: found pattern: requests with very large initial prefix + long idle then resume cause chunked assembler to mis-handle trailers. Opening ticket for parser hardening.
Sasha: for live mitigation, we should also add conservative buffer cap: drop individual chunk > 4MB instead of trying to assemble. Patch in config and reload.
Anna: pushing config change to cap_chunk_size=4MB in feature flags; reload gateway config.
Anna: cap applied, reload done. Early telemetry: further reduction in chunked parsing errors.
Raj: notify support and affected accounts: recommend clients switch to paged fallback if they need long running sessions. Mia, can you draft an outbound note we can paste to support?
Mia: drafting now. Quick note ready: "We're experiencing elevated streaming errors in us-east-1. We've switched affected traffic to paged fallback and applied a config cap to mitigate chunked-encoding issues. Engineers are investigating parser fixes; we will provide ETA within 4 hours." Want me to post to status.redwood?
Sasha: yes please post to status and cc account teams.
oncall-bot: @raj acknowledged; handing monitoring to @sasha for next 30m while raj continues debugging.
Raj: digging into core dump I pulled from gw-2 earlier. Stack shows chunked-assembler race on connection close path. Repro harness incoming from qa to simulate long-idle-stream.
Anna: added temporary rate-limit on concurrent streaming sessions per token (100 concurrent -> 20) for heavy customers to limit blast radius.
Mia: support posted status page and CS notified customers with elevated errors. No P0 customers impacted but several enterprise customers reported blips.
Sasha: rolling more restarts complete. Metrics stable at ~1% error rate now. Keeping fallback on for 1 hour then evaluate.
Raj: created follow-up ticket for parser fix (ENG-STREAM-4821) and a postmortem. Action items: permanent patch (low latency), improve e2e for big chunked bodies, add synthetic tests that simulate long-idle resumes.
Anna: thanks team. I'll keep the feature-flag fallback scheduled until the next deploy proves stability. If error stays under 1% for 30m, we'll flip fallback off.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to MONITORING. Severity reduced. No active customer timeouts reported after mitigations. Incident owner: raj. Follow-ups: ENG-STREAM-4821, support notifications.
Sasha: leaving handoff notes in the runbook, switching to monitor channel. Good job everyone :tada:
oncall-bot: @sasha is now primary monitoring. Handing back to @raj at 11:00 UTC or earlier if stable.
Raj: closing loop: will open PR within 2 business days and schedule a canary deploy. Closing thread when postmortem published.
Anna: thanks all. Closing checks at +60m if stable.
